concept.title: Sign-In and Security: Questions and Answers

section.title: Do I Need Two-Step Verification?
section.p: No, but we recommend it. With it, a password alone isn’t enough to get into your books. Turn it on under Your account > Security. Administrators can require it for everyone in the company.

section.title: Which Authenticator Apps Work?
section.p: Any app that generates time-based codes, such as the ones built into most password managers. Ledgerly shows a QR code to scan when you set it up.

section.title: I Lost My Phone. How Do I Sign In?
section.p: Use one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. If you have none, ask your administrator to reset your second factor. They’ll check who you are first.

section.title: Why Was I Signed Out?
section.p: Ledgerly signs you out after 14 days, after a password change, and when an administrator removes a device. If that happens more often, check that your browser keeps cookies for ledgerly.example.

section.title: Can I See Where My Account Is Signed In?
section.p: Yes. Your account > Sign-in activity lists every device, with its last activity and approximate location. Select Sign out next to any device you don’t recognise, and then reset your password.

section.title: Does the Support Team Ever Ask for My Password by Email?
section.p: Never. A message that asks for your password, a code, or a payment to keep your account isn’t from us. Forward it to security at ledgerly.example and delete it.
